Quality Assurance Software Engineer Analyst

Recruiters, HR Managers, Hiring Managers connect with me to get access to my network deep in industry leadership.
***************

I am a  process oriented  Quality Assurance Software Engineer Analyst   with a drive and passion  for the testing discipline always looking to find  innovated ways to improve the test process, quality and product customer experience.  


 A  hands-on team lead and member who is highly motivated and  demonstrates  a strong understanding of the STLC   implementing test plans,  testcases,  finding defects,  execution and test metrics.


Effectively  troubleshoots problems to increase team efficiencies and minimize customer  product impacts.  Adapts quickly to changing requirements under pressure product deadlines. I truly enjoy testing, learning new technology, and finding those bugs!!  


To brainstorm on what I can bring to you as a Quality Assurance Engineer, please call me now at (914) 489-0314.

company.name: Leaders in Quality Assurance Software Engineering & Analysis

positions.title: Seeking new opportunities in Quality Assurance Analyst | Test Engineer
positions.description:
Seeking a challenging career as a QA Test Engineer  working on a team who are proud to be testers, who have a  strong desire to make its software's product quality the best of breed, and who care and take pride in what we deliver to our customers. 

An opportunity to broaden expertise as a Mainframe System Support Programmer is also an area of interest.  


Love to get my hands dirty in all aspects, bleeding edge technologies and  Products.

Expertise in
 
Test plans 
Testcase creation and execution                 
Strong Problem Analysis 
Software Testing Life Cycle                             
Agile   SDLC  process
Defect triage  prioritization 
Hands on Test Team Lead  
Mainframe Test and system support 
WebSphere Application Server Administration    
Software IT  Capability 
Driven,  care and passion for the test discipline
Mentors    Good team-working skills  
load   stress  tooling like JMeter, WebSphere Studio 
Customer liaison   [focus on problem resolution
IWD IBM Workload Developer Hypervisor z/VM, VMware ESX  PowerVM

positions.title: Software Engineer | Quality Assurance Test Analyst
positions.description:
Performed system level testing on  Mainframe z/OS  hardware for various WebSphere functional areas. Main focus areas are WebSphere installation, customization, and migration
Planned and managed   hardware/ software release levels  and compatibility to established test environments to facilitate testing current and supported WebSphere releases for test team.
Provided diagnostic expertise to team members in and outside our group in areas of WebSphere, Mainframe (z/OS), JCL and DB2 and SQL.
Produced new testcases to improved test coverage and quality based on customer investigated  problems.  
Originated automation and maintained  DB2 databases for  numerous test applications through the use of JCL and DB2 SQL testcase executions by team.   
Performed WebSphere product testing for WAS v61, through WAS 855 of the WebSphere product on multiple WebSphere supported  platforms.
To ensure product usability and quality of  IBM Installation Manager, performed, performed SMP/E installs of IBM Installation Manager. 
Performed system testing on WebSphere hypervisor systems for cloud computing on VMware ESX, zVM(Linux), PowerVM(AIX) , and Pure Systems(IPAS)(Red Hat, SuSe) .    
Represented and managed the  resolution of customer discovered problems during beta, pre-production  and production test phases for external WebSphere French customer  PSA-Peugeot-Citroen,  Bessencourt, France.  Engaged support teams when needed to facilitate resolution.

positions.title: Team Lead | Quality Assurance Test  Engineer Analyst
positions.description:
•  Function test leader for local and remotely based residing in  Boeblingen, Germany, Austin TX , Rochester  MN and Poughkeepsie, NY. 
•  Design testplans,  test use cases, tooling, problem debug, and hardware for test team .
•  Provided  debug analysis to determine weaknesses in product for future test effort
•  Provided reusable code/ automation to function testers to support their testing.
•  Managed timelines and milestone targets for team. Provided reporting to management on release test  progress. 
•  Conducted test resource sizings for upcoming test efforts. 
•  Provided test environment configurations creation and maintenance for product releases supported (eWLM, WLM). 
•  Conducted training to new remote test team members located in Austin, TX. Sessions included component knowledge,  test approaches, defect creation and content and test process. 
•  Perform system/function testing on multiple platforms such as Solaris, x/p/Linux, AIX, Windows and zOS functions focusing on Installation, migration and configuration of  the eServer eWLM Product software.
•  Performed system testing of Mainframe zOS WLM function based on WebSphere in support of eWLM product. Mediated and component test knowledge  between function and system test teams to minimize defect workload impact.
•  Determine resource allocations for test team for release planning and worked with  management 
•  Provided hardware/machine requirements to support platform matrix.

positions.title: Promotion to Advisory level
positions.description:
Managed Test strategies against deadlines for Quality assurance functional test group, increasing quality by promoting process changes such as test case porting to improve next test phase acceptance criteria. 

Mentored and transferred test project to IBM Germany team, compiling sizings, managing hardware and software requirements to establish new test bed environments, implementation of  tester education  presentations, and software test life cycle controls and methodologies.

honors.title: Thanks Awards
honors.description:
Appreciation Awards given by Peers for assisting   in getting the job done. 
14 Awards were given to me from 2005-2010.

honors.title: IBM Outstanding Technical Achievement Award
honors.description:
• Lead transfer of Quality Assurance Function test mission from IBM Poughkeepsie, NY  to IBM Boeblingen, Germany. 
 Activities included: 

Skills transfer > test planning, testcase  creation and maintenance, testcase regression buckets maintenance, problem analysis, defect creation and tracking of Test bugs and progress measurements.

Required multiple trips for  education sessions  for  Germany test team  skills transfer.

Established hardware and software requirements for establishing test environments in  IBM Boeblingen  Germany 

Supported Germany test team after transfer to help with smoother transfer of testplan and managing strategies and deadlines.
